verdict.summary: The exact v9 bytes preserve the ordered v9-to-v8-to-v7-to-v6-to-v5-to-v2 projection, all nine v9 atomic delta paths, EventEnvelopeV3/lifecycle, store-provenance, numeric policy, and blocked G19/non-promotion state. The v8 exact-code and startup defects are substantially repaired. The package is nevertheless rejected because its claimed exact oracle uses Python value equality where recursive JSON type identity is required. Of 319 value-equal type-changing inherited scalar mutations, 270 were accepted with no finding and 49 produced a forbidden INTERNAL-class finding; none produced a correct named controlled result. The same defect admits non-integer machine schema versions, and the machine parser is not mode-bound for selftestCounts.

blockingFindings.title: The claimed exact oracle uses value-coercive equality instead of recursive JSON type identity
requirementsViolated: The v9-to-v8 and inherited projections are declared exact deep comparisons, not value-coercive Python comparisons.
The machine result is a closed object with exact field types and mode-dependent selftestCounts nullability.
Every API, parser, CLI, machine, mutation, and nested-process vector must end in its exact named non-internal outcome, with no dirty-base escape.
evidence: A 319-case independent sweep over 168 inherited numeric/boolean leaves produced 270 zero-finding acceptances and 49 forbidden INTERNAL-class outcomes; no case produced a correct named controlled finding.
An isolated normal invocation and an isolated selftest invocation both returned PASS for a type-changed dirty candidate and reported a hash different from the frozen candidate hash.
The machine parser accepted two non-integer schemaVersion representations that compare equal to integer one.
The machine parser accepted a closed non-null selftestCounts object on an ordinary PASS because parsing is not bound to invocation mode.

The unsupported-mode regression control compares whole dictionaries with Python equality, so an equality-confusable schema scalar is not distinguished even though the exact emitted frozen record is currently correct.
Ordinary non-value-equal dirt remains controlled, confirming that the escape is specific to missing JSON type identity rather than failure to run validation.
blockingFindings.impact: The checker can certify non-frozen candidates whose scalar JSON types changed, including exact-version, lifecycle/schema, state, count, and boolean fields. Some other type-confusable mutations surface only as the generically forbidden OP9-INTERNAL-INHERITED-CHECK. Machine-child schemas can likewise be accepted outside their declared exact types or invocation mode. Therefore the checker does not prove its exact projection, closed machine transport, dirty-base refusal, or no-internal oracle claims.
requiredV10Repair: Preserve the exact v9 candidate, checker, this rejection review, v8 rejection, and full declared lineage byte-identically as rejected inputs.

Implement one recursive JSON type-strict comparator used for complete candidate construction, every projection, every semantic slice, expected-vs-actual result objects, and mutation application checks: require identical node types before values; bool is never int, int is never float; require exact object key sets and exact list order while treating JSON object member order as non-authoritative.

Do not patch individual scalar paths. Apply the comparator to root envelope fields, inherited subtrees, lifecycle/EventEnvelopeV3, store provenance, numeric policy, G19/non-promotion state, predecessor projections, and unsupported-mode records.

Make machine validation invocation-mode aware. Normal PASS requires selftestCounts null; successful selftest PASS requires exactly the closed nonnegative-integer count object; FAIL requires null artifact hash and counts plus nonempty findings; UNSUPPORTED remains a separate exact closed record with exit 3.

Require exact types and nullability before equality for every machine and finding field; retain duplicate-key rejection, one-record stdout, empty stderr, closed keys, code-field-only extraction, exact duplicate-free code sets, and generic INTERNAL/EXCEPTION/TRACEBACK/outward-exception rejection.

Add an exhaustive value-equal/type-changing mutation sweep over every numeric and boolean scalar leaf and every machine/unsupported/count field, including true, false, integral floats, signed zero, nullability, unknown keys, and reordered keys. Every applied mutation must receive its exact named code; no empty, INTERNAL, arbitrary FULL-only, failure-to-apply, or no-op escape is permitted.

Retain and rerun the weak subset/text/detail/additional/duplicate/near/malformed/human/FULL-substitution mutants, isolated startup/child sanitation, numeric/resource/fixture/nested matrices, and thirteen-input trust controls.
Preserve the v9 oracle/startup repairs and all inherited frozen semantics, then obtain fresh review by a reviewer who authored neither v10 nor its checker.

requiredSuccessorConditions: Close OP9-IR-01 with the recursive type-strict and mode-specific repair above; no narrower per-field equality patch is sufficient.
Reverse-project exact v10 bytes through unchanged v9, v8, v7, v6, v5, and v2 with no additional authorized semantic path.
Keep isolated python3 -I -B as the sole conformance boundary, retain early sys-only refusal, sanitize every child, and keep at most one non-authoritative nonisolated negative control.
Retain numeric, resource, UTF-8, duplicate, fixture-kind, nested totality, authenticated-buffer, post-read substitution, and weak-oracle protections.
Obtain fresh independent review before application, integration, product acceptance, freeze, seal, or release.
